summary_1line: After Hanuman devastates Lanka, Ravana admits concern and gathers his ministers, explaining principles of good counsel before asking for strategies against Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana sits on his throne in the golden court of Lanka with bowed head while demon ministers gather around after Hanuman’s destruction of the city.
The burning and shattered palaces of Lanka smoke in the background as anxious rakshasa chiefs assemble before Ravana.
